response.overview: Montis "Dat Damn Monty" Harrison is determined to live his dream as a stand-up comedian. Lisa, the apple of his eye, is also his number one fan. Things become interesting when the couple move back home to Houston after Monty's football career is halted by an injury. Lisa's dad and friends on both sides create a tug of war that threatens to split the couple up.
response.tagline: Where comedy & romance meet. For better and for worse.
response.title: Live Love Laugh
